Zelensky:

I just spoke with President Trump. It was an important conversation, and we managed to discuss many things.

We agreed to meet in New York, and this meeting could bring about significant changes. There is a diplomatic dynamic at play.

Russia's Medvedev:

The United Russia party performed with dignity. 

And the citizens of our country maintain trust in our leading political force and consider it possible to entrust it with further governance at various levels of state power. https://t.co/jym5ozISWx
